mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yan_notification_delivery_outbox(task_key,receiver_id,actor_id,article_id,comment_id,root_comment_id,type,content,status,retry_count,max_retry,next_retry_at,process_count) VALUES(#{taskKey},#{receiverId},#{actorId},#{articleId},#{commentId},#{rootCommentId},#{type},#{content},'PENDING',0,#{maxRetry},NOW(3),0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE receiver_id=VALUES(receiver_id),actor_id=VALUES(actor_id),article_id=VALUES(article_id),comment_id=VALUES(comment_id),root_comment_id=VALUES(root_comment_id),type=VALUES(type),content=VALUES(content),max_retry=VALUES(max_retry),retry_count=CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') THEN 0 ELSE retry_count END,next_retry_at=CASE WHEN status='PROCESSING' THEN next_retry_at ELSE NOW(3) END,locked_until=CASE WHEN status='PROCESSING' THEN locked_until ELSE NULL END,last_error=NULL,dead_letter_at=NULL,status=CASE WHEN status='PROCESSING' THEN status ELSE 'PENDING' END,update_time=NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM yan_notification_delivery_outbox WHERE status='PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE yan_notification_delivery_outbox SET status='PROCESSING',locked_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND),update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3)
UPDATE yan_notification_delivery_outbox SET process_count=process_count+1,last_process_at=NOW(3),update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE yan_notification_delivery_outbox SET status='SUCCEEDED',locked_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE yan_notification_delivery_outbox SET status=CASE WHEN retry_count+1 >= max_retry THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END,next_retry_at=CASE WHEN retry_count+1 >= max_retry THEN next_retry_at ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND) END,locked_until=NULL,last_error=#{reason},dead_letter_at=CASE WHEN retry_count+1 >= max_retry THEN NOW(3) ELSE dead_letter_at END,retry_count=retry_count+1,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE yan_notification_delivery_outbox SET status='PENDING',locked_until=NULL,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND locked_until < NOW(3)

UPDATE yan_notification_delivery_outbox SET retry_count=CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 0 ELSE retry_count END,status='PENDING',next_retry_at=NOW(3),locked_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,dead_letter_at=NULL,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE status IN ('PENDING','FAILED')
